text:
alex: Quick sync — for the new internal inference API I'm torn: proto-first gRPC between services for strict contracts vs REST/JSON for simplicity (and console/browser UX). Thoughts?

sasha: Proto-first wins for model teams (strong types + codegen). But we need a thin gateway for browser clients. gRPC-web + envoy is a common pattern. :thumbsup: 

jon: Telemetry note: our console traces expect HTTP route names right now. gRPC streaming and method names get lost unless we map them at the gateway. Metering/quotas are also easier by path.

maya: +1 proto-first. Proposal: keep internal meshes gRPC, expose a REST facade for external/console routes. Use ts-proto / grpc-web for the console CLI where we can. Avoid duplicating business logic in the gateway.

priya: Warning — adding a translation layer can add ms of latency and complicate batching semantics for inference. If gateway does prefix-to-method translation we must preserve the original headers for KV cache keys.

alex: Good point re: KV cache. Also rollout UX: we want canaries to route by model-version header + fallback to lower-tier model. Gateway needs to be able to rewrite and fallback.

maya: Example envoy route snippet for a 1:1 translation (pseudo):
```yaml
- name: translate-inference
  match: { path_prefix: "/v1/infer/" }
  route: { cluster: grpc-inference, upgrade_configs: [ { "grpc": {} } ] }
  typed_per_filter_config:
    envoy.filters.http.grpc_json_transcoder:
      proto_descriptor: "/etc/protos/inference.pb"
      services: ["inference.Frontend"]
```
This keeps the proto as source of truth and lets Envoy emit an HTTP route for metrics.

jon: We should also standardize a telemetry header (x-rw-request-id) propagated from gateway to backend so traces can be joined regardless of transport.

sasha: For quotas: implement token bucket at gateway keyed by consumer+route. For internal-to-internal gRPC calls we can also apply per-method quotas in the service mesh, but gateway should be first line of defense.

priya: Testing matrix suggestion: run perf tests for 128/512/2048 token payloads across: direct gRPC, gRPC via envoy (grpc-web), REST facade (envoy grpc_json_transcoder), and JSON->gRPC translation in our app-layer. Capture p50/p95/p99 and extra latency introduced by translation and header propagation.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: api-gateway/v2 -> 5% traffic -> route translation plugin enabled. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/1122 :robot_face: 

alex: OK action items:
  - run priya's perf matrix (who can own infra runs?)
  - prototype envoy translate config + telemetry header passthrough (maya)
  - doc rollout UX for model-version routing and automatic fallback (sasha)

sasha: I'll draft the rollout doc and include example curl + grpc-web snippets. @priya can you own perf runs?

priya: I can run the perf tests tomorrow, will post results in this thread.

alex: Thanks all — let's keep gateway as a translation layer only (no business logic) and prefer proto-first internally. We'll revisit if perf or latency budgets force simplification. :white_check_mark:
